title: andropogon intermedius subvar. glaber
intro: Andropogon intermedius subvar. glaber, commonly known as East Indian thyme grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat various digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of East Indian thyme grass include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
